hard_rules: Function and visuals are scored separately; a visual score cannot override a failed completion gate.
A black, static, or uncaught-error capture receives no credit for visual polish hidden behind the failure.
Wrong wheel or prop rotation, implausible steering orientation, camera jumps, or obvious animation discontinuities reduce motion coherence even when a still frame looks attractive.
Offline fixed-step footage may support visual inspection but cannot earn real-time performance credit.
Copied protected characters, tracks, levels, logos, audio, or assets invalidate originality credit.
All judged arms use the same viewport, seed contract, capture method, and randomized anonymous presentation order.
